BiblicalUsage: The flood is the word for the deluge, and Jesus uses it twice as the picture of His coming: in the days of Noah they were eating and drinking and marrying until the flood came and took them all away. Peter adds that God spared not the old world but saved Noah, a preacher of righteousness. The flood is the warning that normal life is no shelter from judgment.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the flood still preaches, because people go on eating and drinking right up to the day the door shuts. I hold that Noah's ark is the picture of Christ: the only shelter is the one God provides, and the time to enter it is now.
